method: Win chance is the median of every board's no-margin chance: each sportsbook once, plus the prediction market when its game has $25k+ traded. Range is the lowest to highest board. Value means a board's price implies 3+ points less chance than the consensus. Player colors compare the matchup to league average and are context, not picks. NFL pass catcher scores are AnonMav Coverage Edge, estimated from public play by play.
